# Zyte Api

Zyte API is a web scraping solution that automates data extraction from websites, handling challenges like bans and dynamic content.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/zyte-api/.

## Actions

- **Get Zyte API Status Rollup** (read-only): Retrieve the overall status rollup for the zyte api.
- **List Zyte API status incidents** (read-only): List the 50 most recent incidents on the zyte api status page.
- **Zyte API: Get Unresolved Incidents** (read-only): Retrieve unresolved incidents from zyte status api.
- **Zyte Status Summary** (read-only): Get a summary of status indicators, component statuses, unresolved incidents, and scheduled maintenances.
- **Fetch Active Scheduled Maintenances** (read-only): Fetch currently active scheduled maintenances.
- **Get scheduled maintenances** (read-only): Get the 50 most recent scheduled maintenances (upcoming and completed) from zyte status api.
- **Upcoming Scheduled Maintenances** (read-only): Retrieve upcoming scheduled maintenance windows.
- **Zyte API Components** (read-only): Fetch the list of zyte api service components and their statuses.
